jcr:content.jcr:description: Explore Anamnesis Cloud features - knowledge graph creation, dual viewer, AI tools, multi-language extractors, and impact analysis.

pageheader.title: Features
pageheader.subtitle: Powerful tools for architecture exploration, dependency analysis, and AI-assisted coding.

cards_core.title: Core Capabilities
cards_core.subtitle: From graph creation to AI integration - everything built into your VS Code workflow.

item0.description: Right-click any workspace folder and generate a unified knowledge graph. One graph per project, uploaded to Anamnesis Cloud.

item1.description: Browse all your graphs from the Anamnesis activity bar. Open owned and shared company projects instantly.

item2.description: Fast Table view for large graphs with text filtering, plus Cytoscape graph view with force-directed, circle, grid, concentric, and preset layouts.

item3.description: Inspect label, kind, community, source file, line number, and neighbors. Click any node to jump to source code.

item4.description: Enable AI Tools to register an MCP server and Cursor skill so agents query the graph before searching files.

item5.description: TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Maven, HTL/AEM, AEM Content XML, HTML, Apache, NGINX, Bash, Jenkins, and Markdown architecture docs.

item6.description: Understand blast radius before editing. Trace dependencies, callers, callees, and shortest paths across your codebase.

item7.description: Configure server URL, credentials, default tag, and test connection. Works with Anamnesis Cloud or local development.

cards_viewer.title: Dual Viewer
cards_viewer.subtitle: Choose the right view for your graph size and exploration style.

item0.description: Fast rendering and text filtering for large graphs. Sort and search nodes by label, kind, community, source file, and line number. Ideal for precise lookups.

item1.description: Force-directed, circle, grid, concentric, and preset layouts. Community-colored nodes, interactive pan/zoom, and click-to-source navigation.

cards_types.title: Supported Project Types
cards_types.subtitle: One unified graph across application code, AEM, infrastructure, and documentation.

item0.description:
• Node / TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Java (Spring, OSGi, microservices)
  • Maven multi-module monorepos
  • Plain HTML static sites

item1.description:
• HTL / Sightly components
  • AEM Content XML (.content.xml)
  • Sling Models (Java)
  • Maven ui.apps modules

item2.description:
• Apache Web Server (.conf, .any)
  • NGINX (.conf, .upstream.conf)
  • Bash deployment scripts
  • Jenkins pipelines

item3.description:
• Markdown architecture docs (.md)
  • Projects, modules, API routes
  • Mermaid flow diagrams
  • Cross-project dependency edges

cta_ai.title: Enable AI Tools
cta_ai.subtitle: Run Anamnesis: Enable AI Tools (MCP + Skill) to register an MCP server and Cursor skill. Agents query the graph before searching files.
